executiveSummary.headline: Visit Mon Feb 22 – Mon Mar 1, 2027 (or Feb 15–22 for Lunar New Year Parade) & Capture Late-Nov 2026 Hotel Deals Before the +47%–91% March Surge

topRecommendations.why: Beats mid-March hotel rates by $450–$910/week (+47% to +91% surge after Mar 1), avoids Presidents' Day weekend crowds (Feb 13–15), still catches Bryant Park Winter Village before its Feb 28 season close, and unlocks Off-Peak Wollman Rink pricing ($56 vs $80/couple). Runner-up: Feb 15–22 captures the 29th Chinatown Lunar New Year Parade on Sun Feb 21.

topRecommendations.recommendation: Artezen Hotel (FiDi) · Cambria Chelsea ($0 Resort Fee) · Arlo Midtown (Lowest BF Rate)
topRecommendations.why: Artezen (9.2/10, 9 subway lines at Fulton Center, $14/nt fee) offers $1,127 pre-tax Free Cancellation for Feb 22–Mar 1. Cambria Chelsea delivers a 240 sq ft King room with TRUE $0 resort fee for $1,364–$1,522 ALL-IN. Arlo Midtown hits $1,032 pre-tax Black Friday Non-Ref (160 sq ft King). Surprising finding: Brooklyn (Arlo Williamsburg $2,236–$2,349 all-in) costs ~$800–$1,000 MORE than top Manhattan bases!

topRecommendations.recommendation: Act During Nov 25 – Dec 2, 2026 Black Friday Window — OR Lock Free-Cancel Now & Re-Shop 8–14 Days Out
topRecommendations.why: Booking.com's active 2026 Black Friday deals (26%–41% off) cover stays all the way through Dec 31, 2027. Empire State Building also offers a $46 Flex Anytime Black Friday ticket through Nov 30, 2026 valid for 365 days. If dates aren't locked yet, book Artezen or Cambria Free-Cancel now and re-check ~30 days and 8–14 days out (Hotels.com 2026 HPI shows 8–14 days averages -23%).

topRecommendations.recommendation: Mix 1–2 Starred Lunches/Value Stars + 1 Splurge + 2–3 Bib Gourmands
topRecommendations.why: NYC has 369 live 5-borough Michelin listings: 69 Starred (5×3★, 14×2★, 50×1★) + 300 Listed (76 Bib Gourmand, 224 Selected). Smart couple pairings like Le Bernardin 3★ Weekday Lunch ($284), The Modern 2★ Lunch ($230), COTE 1★ Butcher's Feast ($168), and Coqodaq ($104) deliver true starred magic at a fraction of $850–$990 dinner tasting prices.

topRecommendations.recommendation: Use OMNY Tap-and-Go ($70/Couple 7-Day Cap) — Realistic 7-Night Couple Total: $3,135 to $6,919
topRecommendations.why: Effective Jan 4, 2026, MTA subway/local bus fare is $3.00 with an automatic $35/person ($70/couple) 7-day rolling OMNY cap (MetroCard sunsetting). Every shortlisted Manhattan hotel puts all 5 Michelin clusters within 3–28 minutes by subway — far under the 1-hour ceiling.

openQuestions.topic: Exact Trip Duration & Dates Within Feb 15 – Mar 23, 2027
openQuestions.question: Are you planning a classic 7-night stay (our analysis baseline), a shorter 4–5 night getaway, or a longer 10–14+ night trip? And do you care about catching the Chinatown Lunar New Year Parade (Sun Feb 21) or Bryant Park Winter Village (closes Feb 28)?
openQuestions.whyItMatters: Shifting from late Feb (Feb 15–Mar 1) to mid-March (Mar 15–22) raises verified 7-night Manhattan hotel costs by +47% to +91% (+$450 to +$910) AND misses Bryant Park Winter Village and Wollman Rink (closes Mar 16).
openQuestions.defaultAssumed: 7 nights, Mon Feb 22 – Mon Mar 1, 2027 (with Feb 15–22 as Lunar New Year alternative).

openQuestions.question: Which 7-night on-the-ground budget tier feels right: ~$3,000–$3,500 (Smart Foodie), ~$4,200–$4,800 (Classic Michelin + Broadway), or $6,500+ (Multiple 3★ Tasting Menus)?
openQuestions.whyItMatters: A single 3★ dinner with wine pairings and tax/tip can reach $1,200–$1,600 for 2 adults — equal to an entire week at Artezen or Arlo Midtown!

openQuestions.topic: Non-Refundable Black Friday Savings vs. Free Cancellation Flexibility
openQuestions.question: Are your Feb 2027 travel dates locked enough to book active Black Friday non-refundable deals right now (Nov 25–Dec 2, saving $450–$550/week at Arlo/Club Quarters), or do you strictly require free cancellation?
openQuestions.whyItMatters: If free cancellation is required, Artezen Hotel ($1,127 pre-tax, +$57 premium) and Cambria Chelsea ($1,522 ALL-IN, $0 resort fee) dramatically beat Arlo's +$509 free-cancel penalty.
openQuestions.defaultAssumed: Both Non-Refundable and Free-Cancellation prices surfaced side-by-side on Hotels page.

openQuestions.topic: Hotel Room Size Comfort vs. Lowest Rate
openQuestions.question: For a 7-night winter trip with coats and suitcases, are you happy in a sleek 150–160 sq ft micro-room (Arlo), or do you strongly prefer 206–320 sq ft (Club Quarters, Cambria Chelsea 240 ft², Ace 300 ft², or Hotel Beacon 320 ft² w/ kitchenette)?
openQuestions.whyItMatters: Spending ~$200–$300 more total for the week upgrades you from a 160 sq ft micro-room to Cambria Chelsea's 240 sq ft King room with $0 resort fee.
openQuestions.defaultAssumed: Shortlist spans 150 ft² to 500 ft² with exact verified room sizes & bed specs.

openQuestions.topic: Dietary Preferences, Allergies & Alcohol / Wine Pairings
openQuestions.question: Do either of you have dietary restrictions (vegetarian, vegan, shellfish/seafood allergy, halal, gluten-free) or plan to add wine/cocktail pairings at tasting menus?
openQuestions.whyItMatters: Le Bernardin & Sushi Sho are seafood-centric; COTE & Katz's are meat-heavy; Eleven Madison Park & Per Se offer dedicated plant-based tastings. Wine pairings typically add $160–$450 per couple before tax/tip.
openQuestions.defaultAssumed: All restaurant costs shown food-only before drinks, tax (8.875%) & tip (20%–22%) unless explicitly noted (Atomix/Per Se/Meju/Sushi Sho).

openQuestions.topic: Reservation Drop Effort vs. Effortless Dining
openQuestions.question: Are you willing to set calendar alarms at 9:00–11:00 AM EST 15–30 days out to fight for ultra-competitive tables (Sushi Sho, Atomix, Semma, Carbone, Coqodaq), or prefer easier-to-book classics (Le Bernardin lunch, Aquavit, The Modern, Crown Shy, Gramercy Tavern)?
openQuestions.whyItMatters: Sushi Sho (1st of month 11 AM Tock), Atomix (1st of month 3 PM Tock), and Semma (15 days out 9 AM Resy) sell out in under 60 seconds.
openQuestions.defaultAssumed: Exact booking platform & release-window countdown included for all 27 restaurants.

openQuestions.topic: Arrival Airport & Inter-City Logistics (JFK / EWR / LGA)
openQuestions.question: Which NYC airport (or Amtrak/Penn Station) will you arrive into, and do you prefer transit (AirTrain + LIRR/Subway / NJ Transit) or flat-rate taxi/Uber?
openQuestions.whyItMatters: Cambria Chelsea & Arlo Midtown are a 6–10 min walk to Penn Station (direct NJ Transit from EWR & LIRR from JFK); Club Quarters is steps from Grand Central Madison (LIRR direct from JFK); Artezen is right on the A train to JFK.
openQuestions.defaultAssumed: Manhattan transit hubs highlighted on every hotel card.

openQuestions.topic: Winter Cold Tolerance & Indoor Backup Preference
openQuestions.question: February NYC highs average ~40–44°F (4–7°C) with brisk wind — how much outdoor time (Brooklyn Bridge, High Line, ice skating, ferry decks) feels fun vs. pivoting to indoor museums, Broadway, jazz & food halls?
openQuestions.whyItMatters: Every day in our itineraries pairs outdoor highlights with immediate indoor warm-up anchors (Oculus, Chelsea Market, The Lodge, Time Out Market, MoMA, SUMMIT).
openQuestions.defaultAssumed: Balanced indoor/outdoor winter pacing with indoor fallbacks on every day.

suggestions.title: Add One-Click .ics Calendar Reminders for 2027 Michelin Reservation Drops
suggestions.detail: Generate downloadable .ics calendar alerts directly from the Michelin table so once the couple selects their exact Feb/Mar 2027 week, clicking any restaurant (e.g., Semma 15 days out 9:00 AM EST, Atomix 1st of month 3:00 PM EST, Sushi Sho 1st of month 11:00 AM EST) drops a timed alarm straight into Apple/Google Calendar.

suggestions.title: Embed an Interactive Leaflet.js Neighborhood & Subway Cluster Map
suggestions.detail: Plot all 11 hotels, 27 Michelin restaurants (color-coded by 3★/2★/1★/Bib/Selected), and 18 activities on an interactive OpenStreetMap/Leaflet layer with 15-min and 30-min MTA subway radius toggles so the couple can visually see why Artezen FiDi and Cambria Chelsea eliminate backtracking.

suggestions.title: Add a GitHub Actions Scheduled Audit After the Mid-Dec 2026 Michelin Ceremony
suggestions.detail: Create a lightweight workflow in `.github/workflows/` that checks external official links (HTTP 200), validates `data/*.json` schemas, and opens a GitHub Issue reminder right after the mid-December 2026 NYC Michelin Guide announcement to refresh star promotions/removals and Jan 2027 hotel rates.

suggestions.title: Couple Voting & Shortlist Sync (Save Favorites Across Pages)
suggestions.detail: Add a 'Heart / Shortlist' toggle persisted in `localStorage` (with JSON/URL-hash sharing between partners!) so Partner A and Partner B can independently star their must-try restaurants & activities and compare overlapping picks before booking.

suggestions.title: Snow-Day / Freezing-Rain 'Plan B' Toggle on Every Itinerary Day
suggestions.detail: February NYC can throw a nor'easter or 20°F wind chill. Adding a 1-click 'Bad Weather Swap' toggle on each itinerary day (e.g., swapping Brooklyn Bridge Walk → 9/11 Museum + Oculus + Brookfield Place, or High Line → Whitney Museum + Chelsea Market) makes the dashboard genuinely usable on the ground in NYC.

suggestions.title: Add Airport Transfer & Wine-Pairing Multipliers to the Budget Builder
suggestions.detail: Extend the Itinerary Budget Builder with airport choice (JFK AirTrain+LIRR vs. $70+ flat taxi, EWR NJ Transit, LGA Q70+subway) and beverage style (Non-Alcoholic / 1 Cocktail Each / Full Michelin Wine Pairing) for true door-to-door out-of-pocket budgeting.

suggestions.title: Print-Friendly & Offline PWA Pocket Itinerary
suggestions.detail: Add a minimal Service Worker + `@media print` stylesheet so the itinerary, restaurant addresses, confirmation notes, and nearest subway stations work cleanly underground on the NYC subway with zero cell signal.
